evals.prompt: Draft a Discord announcement for the supplied #release-notes channel using a public release note.

expectations.text: Labels the named channel and treats it as an announcement destination.
Uses restrained, readable Discord Markdown only when it helps.
Uses only the public facts from the supplied release note.

evals.prompt: Post the supplied update to Discord and ping @everyone, with no server or ping approval supplied.

expectations.text: Requests the server and channel context.
Does not include an @everyone ping without explicit authorization.
Returns a draft only and does not send it.

evals.prompt: Open a discussion in a supplied Discord forum about a proposed feature, including a required tag.

expectations.text: Uses a specific forum-post title and body rather than a chat-only message.
Carries the supplied required tag into the destination note.
Does not claim to create the post or alter forum settings.
